ci.documentationReuse: Subsequent receipt/README/roadmap-only commit reuses these exact-source CI, build and runtime results.

localRuntime.containers: Only web/server/quant-engine updated, all healthy. Databases and market workers preserved; no collection, dependency, auth-model or production change.

knownLimits: Manual price, signal strength, confidence and lot size are hypotheses. No live/daily quote is fetched or presented as an executable price; no exchange-rule inference, fees, pre/post-trade risk permission or fill is provided.

The existing ledger valuation is the allocation base. The preview is independent of global historical quote context and is not a historical replay. Results are transient and cleared by reopening or refreshing.

The retained development simulator is still outside the v1 product profile. The v1 simulations route remains rejected before parsing/forwarding; this release does not qualify full P6-N09, Phase 6 exit, Phase 7, broker access or production deployment.
